title: SCPN MIF MagLIF Core
description: Governed device-family repository for the magnetised liner inertial fusion (MagLIF) configuration within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, level-0 device physics (the three-stage drive in closed form: azimuthal drive field and pressure of the load current, liner mass and kinetic energy, preheat energy per fuel volume; and ideal axial-flux and adiabatic compression recorded as upper bounds), and tessellated and B-rep models of the fuel column, liner, laser-entrance foil and coil pair. Parameter sets are synthetic or anchored on a filed related public source; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
